name: star-closet-demo-video
description: Star Closet 比赛演示视频（Remotion）。90 秒，1920×1080 横屏与 1080×1920 竖屏两版。

scripts.preview: npm run assets && remotion render DemoLandscape out/preview-landscape.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=28 && remotion render DemoPortrait out/preview-portrait.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=28
scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render DemoLandscape out/star-closet-1920x1080.mp4 && remotion render DemoPortrait out/star-closet-1080x1920.mp4
